input.summary: Insert transition assistance, Content return and certified deletion obligations in § 3.5
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 3.5 addresses only accrued charges, so we have added our standard exit provision: up to six months of transition assistance at IBM's then-current rates, return of our Content in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion after return. We can fall back to 90 days of assistance and export within 30 days if the six-month period is an issue.

ops.text: Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement or any Service Option Attachment for any reason, IBM will: (a) at Customer's request, provide transition assistance for up to six (6) months at IBM's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days, return all Content to Customer in a standard machine-readable format; and (c) after such return, delete all Content from its systems and certify such deletion to Customer in writing.
